description: Add a new slide to the deck at a specified position in the narrative arc.

inputs.after_slide_id: string — insert the new slide after this slide ID
inputs.title: string — proposed slide title
inputs.narrative_role: string — how this slide fits the story (act + purpose)
inputs.data_sources: array of dataset IDs this slide will use (may be empty)

expected_output.description: New slide entry ready to be appended to map/slides.json, pending human approval

steps.purpose: Understand the narrative arc to validate where the new slide fits
Check current slide count (max 20) and assign the next available slide ID
Validate that referenced data_source IDs exist

steps.message: The deck is at the 20-slide limit. Which existing slide should be removed or merged to make room?
steps.purpose: Respect the audience constraint before proceeding

steps.note: Output is a draft. Human must approve before map/slides.json is updated.
